extracted.intended_audience: general consumers considering or new to Hulu subscriptions (U.S./Puerto Rico/Japan audiences primarily)
extracted.subtask_description: A consumer-facing guide that explains what Hulu is, the differences between Hulu and Hulu + Live TV, device compatibility, pricing tiers, add-ons, technical requirements, and how to sign up or cancel. Designed to help readers decide which Hulu plan or bundle fits their needs and how to use the service.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geographic availability
rubrics_metrics.description: Hulu is an on-demand video service available in the U.S., Puerto Rico, and Japan; Disney launched 'Star' via Disney+ for other international markets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Hulu focuses on the U.S. market for the full service and library; in other countries some Hulu content is available via Disney+ (Star) but the full Hulu experience (complete library, Live TV, add-ons) requires the Hulu app/account.

rubrics_metrics.name: Content library and originals
rubrics_metrics.description: Extensive library of popular TV shows, movies, and exclusive original content (examples: Only Murders in the Building, Shogun, The Handmaid’s Tale, Wu-Tang: An American Saga).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Hulu emphasizes newer network TV shows, originals, films, and documentaries. The presence of unique series unavailable elsewhere is a selling point when choosing the service.

rubrics_metrics.name: Early access to broadcast episodes
rubrics_metrics.description: Hulu gives people early access to episodes from many traditional broadcasters — typically within a week, sometimes within a day, after airing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This differentiator vs. services like Netflix/Amazon Prime Video is important for viewers who want recent network episodes without cable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Download / offline viewing limits and rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Hulu added offline downloads in 2019; viewers can download up to 25 titles across five different devices, have up to 30 days to watch downloaded content, and 48 hours to finish a started title before the download expires.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Offline downloads are limited to Hulu’s ad-free plans. Users must be aware of device and title caps and expiration windows when relying on downloads for travel or offline use.

rubrics_metrics.name: Hulu + Live TV functionality
rubrics_metrics.description: Hulu + Live TV allows subscribers to watch live TV (with ads) and on-demand programming, including local news and live sports, plus everything in Hulu’s on-demand tier.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Hulu + Live TV can replicate a cable-like experience without a satellite/cable subscription, but includes its own limitations (see streaming quality caveats) and offers a no-ad premium option and premium-channel add-ons for extra cost.

rubrics_metrics.name: Channel lineup for Live TV
rubrics_metrics.description: Hulu + Live TV’s channel lineup includes entertainment (Bravo, MTV, TBS, TNT, Comedy Central), educational (Discovery, History), sports (ESPN, FS1), news (CNN, Fox News), and family channels (Cartoon Network, Disney Channel, Nickelodeon).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Channel availability covers a wide range of genres; customers should check current channel lists and premium channel add-ons for specific networks they care about.

rubrics_metrics.name: Device compatibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Hulu and Hulu + Live TV are available on many devices: Android, iOS, Roku, Apple TV, Amazon Fire TV, Fire tablets, Chromecast devices, Android TV, Google TV, Mac and PC browsers, select LG and Samsung smart TVs, gaming consoles (Xbox Series X, PlayStation 5), and more.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify your preferred streaming device is supported before subscribing. Device availability impacts viewing locations (TV, mobile, console) and feature support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pricing tiers and plan distinctions
rubrics_metrics.description: Traditional Hulu ad-supported Basic: $10/month ($100/year); Hulu (No Ads): $19/month. Multiple bundle and Live TV price permutations are offered (examples include $83/month, $96/month, $88/month depending on ad/no-ad choices and included services).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Plans differ by ad presence, Live TV inclusion, and whether Disney+ or ESPN+ are bundled. Pricing is subject to change and the guide lists current options as examples; consumers should compare costs vs. their usage patterns.

rubrics_metrics.name: Student discount eligibility and price
rubrics_metrics.description: Eligible students can get Hulu (With Ads) for $2/month.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Students should verify eligibility requirements; the student price applies to the ad-supported tier only.

rubrics_metrics.name: Bundles with Disney+ and ESPN+
rubrics_metrics.description: Hulu can be bundled with Disney+ and ESPN+ in multiple configurations (ad-supported or no-ads variants) for combined pricing and broader content access.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Bundles can offer savings and wider content, but not all Hulu content appears inside Disney+; for the full Hulu experience (complete library, Live TV, add-ons) the Hulu app/account is still required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Add-on premium channels and costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Subscribers can add premium channels (examples and listed prices: Max with/without ads $17/$10, Cinemax $10, Starz $10, Paramount+ with Showtime $13) on top of a Hulu subscription.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adding individual premium channels can significantly increase total monthly cost; consider whether cord-cutting savings remain after selecting multiple add-ons.

rubrics_metrics.name: Simultaneous streams and upgrade options
rubrics_metrics.description: Standard Hulu account allows two simultaneous screens; this can be upgraded to unlimited screens at home or three on the go for an extra $10.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Family or multi-household users should assess needed simultaneous-stream allowances and potential upgrade costs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cloud DVR and storage (Live TV)
rubrics_metrics.description: Hulu + Live TV offers unlimited online cloud storage for DVR; standard Hulu accounts do not have the same DVR storage benefits.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Unlimited DVR is a major advantage of Live TV plans for users who record lots of programming; confirm DVR details when comparing plans.

rubrics_metrics.name: Streaming quality and internet speed caveats
rubrics_metrics.description: Live streaming quality may not match cable and can suffer from slower internet speeds or during high-traffic periods; Hulu adjusts quality automatically based on internet speed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users should be aware that live streams are more sensitive to bandwidth and network congestion than on-demand playback. Expect variable quality during peak times.

rubrics_metrics.name: Internet speed requirements by quality level
rubrics_metrics.description: Hulu-recommended download speeds: Standard definition 1.5 Mbps; 720p HD 3 Mbps; 1080p HD 6 Mbps; Hulu + Live TV 8 Mbps; Ultra HD 4K 16 Mbps.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Required bandwidth increases with resolution and number of simultaneous streams. Factor in household internet capacity when choosing plan and video quality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Availability of 4K content
rubrics_metrics.description: Hulu has limited Ultra HD 4K content.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If 4K is a priority, check the specific titles available in 4K and ensure you have sufficient bandwidth (16 Mbps) and compatible devices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trial period, signup, and cancellation policy
rubrics_metrics.description: Hulu offers a seven-day free trial (requires credit card on registration), no long-term contracts, and cancellation is easy online or via customer service; Hulu will retain account information if you resubscribe.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The free trial lets users test the service but requires entering payment info up front. No-contract nature makes switching/canceling straightforward.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cost considerations beyond subscription
rubrics_metrics.description: Subscription affordability should factor in premium add-ons, bundle choices, and the cost of a broadband internet connection necessary for streaming.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cord-cutting savings vary based on chosen bundle/add-ons and internet service cost; customers should evaluate total monthly spend including internet.
